hooks.command: cmd=$(cat | sed -n 's/.*"command"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\(.*\)/\1/p'); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && out=$(npm run check 2>&1) || { echo "$out" | tail -40 >&2; echo 'npm run check failed - commit blocked. Fix the warnings/tests, then commit again.' >&2; exit 2; }
hooks.statusMessage: Running npm run check before commit...
